abilities.name: Superhuman capabilities
abilities.description: All physical stats, such as strength, speed and precision are far beyond human limits

abilities.name: Restoration
abilities.description: Ability to return or undo items or beings to a prior condition in their history via interaction

abilities.name: Elimination
abilities.description: Anything that the right hand of The Hand touches in a sweeping motion is obliterated from this universe, whether it is physical objects or space itself

abilities.name: Sound Generation
abilities.description: Echoes ACT1 has the ability to print anything on any material or individual. If the writing is an onomatopoeia, generally in Katakana, a sound associated with the specific onomatopoeia will be emitted. If a phrase is written in Kanji, the expressions will affect the target's mental condition

abilities.name: Sound Effects
abilities.description: Echoes ACT2 can print a sound effect on any surface. When the sound effect is contacted, an effect associated with the sound is generated, either influencing the person who made contact or the object on which the words are etched.

abilities.name: 3 Freeze
abilities.description: ACT3's signature ability. It applies a "freezing" effect by significantly raising the mass of its target through striking it

abilities.name: Book Transmutation
abilities.description: Power that allows its user to transform any living creature into a book, with pages extending from their forms shaped like the body part it opens from

abilities.name: Memory Removal
abilities.description: By deleting pages, the user makes their target forget any memories described there, along with a corresponding amount of body weight

abilities.name: Written-In Commands
abilities.description: By inscribing within the pages of an individual or entity transformed into a book, the user can modify or obliterate memories, or implant hypnotic-like directives into the individual's mind

techniques.name: Safety Lock
techniques.description: Rohan uses Heaven's Door's ability to write the command "I cannot attack Rohan Kishibe" on one of the person's pages, rendering them incapable of bringing themselves to attack him

abilities.name: Bomb Transmutation
abilities.description: The ability to make any item, whether alive or not, a bomb just by making contact. Once a target has come into contact with the item, Killer Queen can trigger an explosion by placing its right thumb against the middle segment of its index finger

abilities.name: Heat-Seeking Detonation
abilities.description: Sheer Heart Attack is an automatic heat-seeking bomb that targets the warmest object nearby. Once it reaches its target, the detected heat triggers an explosion

abilities.name: High Durability
abilities.description: Sheer Heart Attack's body is nearly indestructible

abilities.name: Identity Concealment
abilities.description: When someone discovers Kira's identity, Killer Queen can be detached from Kira and implanted into their body, turning them into its host. In Hayato's case, the ability activates automatically whenever Kira's identity is revealed verbally or in writing, or when someone questions Hayato about Kira. Upon activation, a miniature version of Killer Queen enters the target's eye and causes an explosion

abilities.name: Time-Looping Bomb
abilities.description: After killing its target, Bites the Dust triggers a temporal loop, rewinding time to approximately one hour before the explosion

abilities.name: Liquid Form
abilities.description: Aqua Necklace may disguise itself as any type of fluid and assume their characteristics

abilities.name: Possession
abilities.description: Aqua Necklace has the ability to seize individuals from within, effortlessly entering their bodies through the victim's mouth to manipulate them

abilities.name: Military Firepower
abilities.description: Bad Company consists of portable soldiers and combat vehicles, engaging in battle like a small army with corresponding firepower

abilities.name: Guilt Entrapment
abilities.description: By causing feelings of guilt, the user can invoke The Lock, which manifests as being fastened to the victim's chest. Subsequently, their guilt increases exponentially and can accumulate with additional charges, represented by The Lock enlarging and becoming weightier

abilities.name: Lie Detection
abilities.description: The Lock is proven to have the ability to identify dishonesty in an individual, as demonstrated during Josuke's cee-lo match against Rohan

abilities.name: Mimicry
abilities.description: Capability to replicate the look of another individual. If the dummy is contacted by someone, it will flawlessly imitate that person's look, voice, and behaviors, including the fingerprints

abilities.name: Forced Synchronization
abilities.description: When Surface takes on the identity of an individual, it can compel that individual to mimic its actions. However, Surface and the target must be positioned facing each other for it to be effective

abilities.name: Hair Manipulation
abilities.description: Love Deluxe is connected to Yukako's hair. This enables her to control her hair using her thoughts with significant power and agility, as well as extend it to remarkable lengths

abilities.name: Electricity Absorption
abilities.description: Red Hot Chili Pepper can absorb electricity to boost its physical strength and speed, as well as heal its wounds

abilities.name: Electrical Transfer
abilities.description: Can exist within and move through electrical currents, allowing it to hide inside power lines or batteries and travel quickly through electrical cables

abilities.name: Melting Darts
abilities.description: Ability to shoot barbed darts that melt anything they hit, whether it's flesh or even metal

abilities.name: Strength in Numbers
abilities.description: Each individual Harvest unit is quite weak, but its fists are still strong enough to punch small holes through human flesh

techniques.name: Harvesting
techniques.description: Shigechi can send Harvest across Morioh to search for and collect a specific type of item that is small and light enough for them to carry, then bring it back to him

techniques.name: Stinger
techniques.description: Each Harvest unit has a stinger that Shigechi can use to inject liquids directly into his opponents' bloodstream

abilities.name: Supernatural Photography
abilities.description: Atom Heart Father is bound to a Polaroid camera that can take pictures with several unusual properties. Most notably, these pictures allow people to see Yoshihiro Kira's ghost, which is normally invisible to the human eye. Yoshihiro can also move around inside the picture and interact with objects within the photographed area

abilities.name: Energy Theft
abilities.description: Boy II Man can steal an opponent's energy whenever Ken wins a game of Rock Paper Scissors against them

abilities.name: Illusory Room Projection
abilities.description: Highway Star can create an illusionary room to lure its targets. The room's appearance depends entirely on the person being lured

abilities.name: Enhanced Sense of Smell
abilities.description: Highway Star has an incredible sense of smell, which Yuya also shares. The Stand can memorize someone's scent and automatically track their location

abilities.name: Body Dismantlement
abilities.description: Highway Star can split itself into multiple pieces while moving at high speeds. It breaks apart into flat, horizontal segments shaped like footprints, which can move independently before coming back together piece by piece

abilities.name: Nutrient Absorption
abilities.description: Highway Star's main ability is to drain nutrients from its victims whenever any part of it touches them, then transfer those nutrients to Yuya to heal him

abilities.name: Occupant Restraint
abilities.description: Super Fly's main ability is to trap a single person inside it. It sustains itself by using the energy of its only occupant. If the victim tries to escape, Super Fly covers them in steel to prevent them from moving

abilities.name: Damage Reflection
abilities.description: Super Fly can also absorb and reflect any damage dealt to its structure as a way of protecting itself

abilities.name: Fear-induced Paper Seal
abilities.description: Enigma can turn objects and people, including its user, into pieces of paper. When dealing with simple objects or animals, Enigma can use its ability without any special conditions. However, to turn a person into paper, the user must first discover the specific habit they show when they're afraid. Once he has seen the target display this habit enough times to be completely sure it's their tell, Enigma can capture them the next time they show it

abilities.name: Attachment
abilities.description: Cheap Trick's main ability is to attach itself to its user's back, starting with Masazo Kinoto. It then constantly tries to make someone else look at the user's back. If someone does, Cheap Trick detaches from its current host, killing them in the process, and attaches itself to the person who looked. It then repeats the same process with its new host

abilities.name: Universal Speech
abilities.description: It can make itself heard and understood by anyone, including people who cannot see Stands and even animals

abilities.name: Curative Cooking
abilities.description: Pearl Jam can cure various ailments through specially prepared dishes. The full limits of this ability are unknown, but it can even heal incurable diseases if the right ingredients are used

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.description: Achtung Baby's ability is linked to Shizuka's stress levels, suggesting that it works as a defense mechanism. It allows her to become invisible, and when she is under extreme stress, everything within a certain distance of her also becomes invisible

abilities.name: Shapeshifting
abilities.description: Earth Wind and Fire allows Mikitaka to transform part or all of his body into any object

abilities.name: Body Part Replacement
abilities.description: Cinderella can replace parts of a person's body by creating new ones from the slots on its hand and then sliding its hand into the body to swap out the original parts

abilities.name: Permanent Body Replacement
abilities.description: If someone wants to make their changes permanent, several additional rules apply. Since changing one's fate for a long time requires a lot of energy, the person must show enough dedication. After being modified, they must apply a special lipstick every 30 minutes for 24 hours, except while sleeping, to maintain the changes. The lipstick acts as a protective layer that holds the energy needed to alter fate

abilities.name: Reincarnation
abilities.description: Stray Cat's first revealed ability is to bring its former user, Tama the cat, back to life as a plant after his death

abilities.name: Feline Physiology
abilities.description: Its leaves are nimble enough to grab objects. It waits for a target to get within range before suddenly reaching out and grabbing it

abilities.name: Aerokinesis
abilities.description: Stray Cat can control the air around it using its whiskers. It mainly uses this ability to create invisible bubbles of compressed air and shoot them at targets within its line of sight. It can also use these bubbles to protect itself from attacks
